description_en: Deletes a user (Alibaba Cloud account) registered in Data Management (DMS)
description_zh: 调用该API可删除已录入DMS的用户（阿里云账号）
name: DeleteUser

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the DMS console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: uid
